Images used (blind_input/round2/no29/): M35-02-0185_R.png, M35-02-0186_L.png, M35-02-0188_L.png, M35-02-0188_R.png, M35-02-0189_L.png
Method: enlarged crops 2.5x-5x with PIL; each line read at enlargement. Worked blind: no other file, key, table or earlier reading consulted.
Notation:
  ?          after a number = unsure of that reading
  [a/b]      two possible readings
  ^          small mark above or after a number
  °          small circle above/after a number
  _+         small cross below
  _v         tick below
  [illegible] number visible but not readable; [clipped] cut off at film edge
  [blotted]  digits covered by an ink blot
  ( ... )    reader's note, not part of the text
  English words inside a run are copied in lower case in place.
  Line numbers are manuscript lines within each run. Full stops after numbers are not reproduced.
  0188 is one page split into L and R halves; lines below are the whole page line (L half then R half joined at the seam).
